errors: A command that imported a downloaded wheel (trove-classifiers) was refused by the auto-mode classifier; I read its classifier list as text with grep instead.
notes: Explore idea: differential-test the three license tools' SPDX parsers against spdx-expression-parse 4.0.0 (bundled in npm). Parsers matched on 50,000 random expressions (now spdx.diff.test.mjs in license-compat-check and lockfile-license-check; each test failed on a seeded precedence fault). Running every SPDX id, all 89 PyPI License:: trove names and the 45 local license strings found word-matching bugs: license-drift-check read 'Proprietary, limited use' as permissive, 'Universal' as source-available, Elastic-2.0 as unknown; lockfile-license-check categorised multi-word names by first word; license-compat-check ignored trove names' parenthesised ids. All fixed with regression tests. Verified: run_venture_tests.py on the 3 slugs, 122 tests pass; check_posts ok. spdx-correct was rejected as an oracle for trove names (EPL-2.0->EPL-1.0 etc.).
